summary: Full testing of Post-Deploy Migration suite (iteration 35). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (auth gating x3, apply-pg-schema applies 6 migrations, mirror-pg-to-mongo returns 266,558 rows across 7 tables, post-deploy-migrate 8 phases ok + idempotent). CLI: both `python -m scripts.mirror_pg_to_mongo` and `python -m scripts.post_deploy_migrate --skip-replay` exit 0 and print success banners. Frontend: Admin → Infra & Data tab renders the new 'Post-Deploy Migration' card with PROD badge + both buttons (data-testid mirror-pg-to-mongo-btn + post-deploy-migrate-btn). Mirror button click integrates successfully with backend. No runtime errors.

minor.issue: Phase keys are prefixed with an index (e.g. '0_hydrate_secrets'). Frontend/operators parsing by exact name will need to strip the '<n>_' prefix. Harmless but worth documenting.

issues: Several Radix Dialog components throw console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and missing Description/aria-describedby — a11y warnings only, not blockers.
Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings for a container where min dimensions are missing.

action_items: (Optional) Document that phases in post-deploy-migrate response are keyed '<index>_<name>' (e.g. '0_hydrate_secrets').
(Optional) Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden) to Radix DialogContent usages to silence a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: apply_pg_schema endpoint correctly iterates ALL 6 migrations via phase_apply_migrations — confirmed applied list has 6 entries with status already_applied.
mirror_pg_to_mongo covers all 7 expected tables (instrument_master, benchmark_master, mf_metadata, mf_performance_ratios, mf_holdings, mf_nav_history, mf_aum_history). Total ~266k rows in ~5s.
post_deploy_migrate implements 7 operational phases (8 including smoke_check) with skip support, idempotent; completes in ~38-40s with skip_replay.
Admin auth gating works on all 3 new endpoints (401 without cookie).
No MongoDB _id leaks observed in JSON responses.
admin_datastores.py is 339 lines — well under the 700-line threshold.
seed_data_creation: None — tests are read-only / idempotent against existing preview data.

Phase map keys are prefixed with index, tests already handle this. mirror_pg_to_mongo + post_deploy_migrate are safe/idempotent; ok to re-run in any fork.
